description: This file defines the EntityIdWithResourceType interface, which combines an EntityId with a resource type and provides factory methods for creation and deserialization, mainly serving as a data representation and utility interface within the caching system.

classes.name: EntityIdWithResourceType
classes.description: An interface representing an entity ID combined with a resource type, with methods to access resource type, ID, optional cache lookup context, serialization, and static factory methods for creation and deserialization.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Retrieves the resource type associated with this entity ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityId associated with this object.

methods.name: getCacheLookupContext
methods.description: Retrieves the optional cache lookup context for this entity ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes this entity ID with resource type to a string.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EntityIdWithResourceType from resourceType and EntityId.

methods.name: of (overload)
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EntityIdWithResourceType from resourceType, EntityId, and CacheLookupContext.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Deserializes an EntityIdWithResourceType from a string.
